item.title: GTA 6 Players Have Already Discovered the Most Evil Crime in the Game
item.description: The long-awaited Grand Theft Auto 6 doesn't technically come out until midnight local time on Nov. 19 , but plenty of eager gamers are taking advantage of the New Zealand trick to play the game early. Even though GTA 6 reviews only dropped a few hours ago, players are already getting up to plenty of hijinks in Leonida. Just like in Red Dead Redemption 2 , it seems like there are plenty of ways for a sincere oopsie or button fumble to spiral out of control pretty fast.

item.title: Game Awards 2026: All Game of the Year Nominees and Predictions
item.description: At this point, we have a good idea of what games will be favored by The Game Awards' voting body : A high Metacritic rating (preferably over 90) is a must; role-playing games and action-adventures are strongly favored, as are games with strong narrative elements; indie and multiplayer games struggle harder for recognition than AAA single-player adventures. We used these metrics to correctly predict last year's winner, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 , and the 2024 winner, Astro Bot . In 2025, we also predicted all six GOTY nominees and correctly called 20 other categories.

item.title: Magic: the Gathering Is Officially Reprinting an Iconic $42 Artifact with Perfect Dune Art
item.description: That scary box that the Bene Gesserit forced Paul Atreides to put his hand into is about to make your Magic: The Gathering artifacts a lot harder to destroy. Pain Box appears in Magic 's new Dune -themed Secret Lair as a new reprint of Darksteel Forge, a powerful $42 card that gives all of your artifacts indestructible. That makes it one of the biggest draws of the "My Arrakis, My Superdrop" Secret Lair revealed Nov. 18, but the Superdrop is also chock-full of unique legendary creatures vying for a spot as your favorite new Commander.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Designers Reveal the Best Commander in Their Dune Crossover
item.description: “My Arrakis, My Superdrop” goes on sale Nov. 30 through the Secret Lair website , and it draws directly from Denis Villeneuve’s cinematic adaptation of Frank Herbert’s universe. (So yes, you’re about to see the likes of Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Florence Pugh, and Rebecca Ferguson on Magic cards.) The Balance of Power Drop introduces eight legendary creatures, while Deserts of Arrakis adds the massive sandworms the Fremen refer to as Shai-Hulud. The halo foil collection Spice rounds out the crossover with five reprints.

item.title: Expedition 33 Narrative Lead Officially Exits Award-Winning Studio
item.description: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 seemingly came out of nowhere to capture the zeitgeist last year. Players enjoyed its old-school turn-based combat and marveled at its painterly environments, but the strong emotional writing captivated players the most. Sandfall Interactive CEO and creative director Guillaume Broche has previously said Clair Obscur is the franchise name and that Sandfall wants to tell more stories set in its world. However, those stories will be told without one of the Expedition 33 team's key members.

item.title: World of Warcraft Forever Officially Hits Player Peak it Hasn't Seen in 15 Years
item.description: It was already clear that World of Warcraft: Forever , Blizzard's reimagining of the early days of the MMO, was a smash hit. During early access, before the game's full release, it brought back plenty of lapsed players and garnered praise. Now, with the dust having settled slightly two weeks after release, it is becoming clear that Forever is returning World of Warcraft to a level of popularity it hasn't seen in years.

item.title: GTA 6 Sets New Record As Highest-Rated Video Game of All Time
item.description: After more than a decade of waiting, Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here. Rockstar Games' new open-world crime adventure game is playable by the masses — at least in some parts of the world — and has been playable by critics for some time. GTA 6 's review embargo lifted on Wednesday, Nov. 18, and more than a hundred reviews have been tabulated by Metacritic. The consensus is clear: GTA 6 is "monumental," "unbelievably fun," and "truly remarkable," critics say.

item.title: GTA 6 Really Is Better On PS5 Than Xbox
item.description: If you’re planning to get Grand Theft Auto 6 at launch, you’ll be able to buy it on two consoles: PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X. But while both are capable pieces of hardware, it sure seems like developer Rockstar Games has a preference between the two. Advertisements for the game have declared that it “plays best on PS5.” Sony has even gotten custom GTA 6 DualSense controllers in celebration of the launch. To some, it could look like GTA 6 is a PS5 exclusive, even though it very much is not.

item.title: Ridley Scott's Sci-Fi Masterpiece Could Return to Theaters in a Shocking Way, Producers Reveal
item.description: Blade Runner, Ridley Scott’s 1982 adaptation of Philip K. Dick’s 1968 novel Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? , is one of the best and most influential sci-fi films of all time, but it took 35 years for it to get a direct sequel. Producers Broderick Johnson and Andrew Kosove acquired the rights to the franchise in 2011 through their production company, Alcon, and used them to develop Denis Villeneuve’s Blade Runner 2049 , which is set 30 years after the events of Scott’s film. Now, the timeline is moving forward again in Blade Runner 2099 , which premieres on Prime Video on Nov. 25, and the producers are already thinking about what’s next for the cyberpunk series after that.

item.title: GTA 6 Hits 99 on Metacritic, Crowned Best Game Ever in a Wave of Rave Reviews
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 has displaced the original Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time as the best video game of all time according to review aggregation site Metacritic . Its Metascore of 99 matches Nintendo's 1998 masterpiece, but is presumably a few decimal points higher behind the scenes.
